import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Basic

open Ideal

variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R]

namespace Ring

open Ideal in
theorem isField_iff_maximal_bot' : IsField R ↔ (⊥ : Ideal R).IsMaximal := by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ let := h.toSemifield; bot_isMaximal, fun hmax ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hf
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hxu⟩ := exists_not_isUnit_of_not_isField hf
  exact hx0 <| span_singleton_eq_bot.mp (hmax.eq_of_le (span_singleton_ne_top hxu) bot_le).symm

theorem not_isField_of_ne_of_ne' {I : Ideal R} (h_bot : I ≠ ⊥) (h_top : I ≠ ⊤) : ¬ IsField R := by
  intro h
  exact h_bot <| ((isField_iff_maximal_bot'.mp h).eq_of_le h_top bot_le).symm

end Ring
